user.title: Zero Grid Controller — Grid sensor
user.description: Select the sensor that measures grid power exchange.

data.name: Integration name
data.grid_sensor_import: Grid import sensor (power drawn from grid)
data.grid_sensor_export: Grid export sensor (power delivered to grid)
data.power_production_sensors: Production sensors (one or more, e.g. inverter)

add_array.title: Add a PV array
add_array.description: Configure the PV inverter output you want the controller to manage.

data.setpoint_entity: Entity that sets the power limit
data.pv_power_entity: PV power sensor (optional, improves cloud detection)
data.inverter_speed: How fast does this inverter respond?

battery.title: Battery (optional)
battery.description: Configure your home battery so the controller can account for it.

data.battery_control_enabled: Let Zero Grid Controller also set battery target

mode_guard.title: Optimizer integration (optional)
mode_guard.description: Connect to an optimizer like Battery Controller to coordinate control modes.

mode_mapping.title: Map optimizer modes
mode_mapping.description: For each mode value of the selected entity, choose what Zero Grid Controller should do.

done.title: Setup complete
done.description: Zero Grid Controller is ready. The controller will start learning your system automatically.

error.split_sensors_required: Both import and export sensors are required for split measurement.
error.computed_sensors_required: At least one consumption sensor and one production sensor are required for computed measurement.

abort.already_configured: Zero Grid Controller is already configured.

speed.title: Response speed
speed.description: Choose how aggressively the controller reacts to grid imbalance.

expert.title: Expert mode
expert.description: Enable expert mode to manually tune PID and estimator parameters. The online auto-tuner is disabled when expert mode is active.

recalibrate.title: Re-run calibration
recalibrate.description: Calibration measures inverter response time and gain. Run this on a sunny day for best results.

options.net: Single net sensor (positive = import or export depending on sign)

grid_sensor_unavailable.title: Grid sensor unavailable
grid_sensor_unavailable.description: The grid power sensor `{entity_id}` is unavailable. Zero Grid Controller cannot function without a valid grid measurement. Check that the sensor is configured correctly and the integration providing it is running.

reset_pid.name: Reset PID
reset_pid.description: Reset the PID integrator and derivative history.

recalibrate.name: Recalibrate
recalibrate.description: Re-run automatic step-response calibration for one or all arrays.

array_name.name: Array name
array_name.description: Name of the array to calibrate. Leave empty to calibrate all arrays.

override_setpoint.name: Override setpoint
override_setpoint.description: Force a setpoint for an array, bypassing PID for up to 5 minutes.

array_name.name: Array name
array_name.description: Name of the array to override.

value.name: Value
value.description: Setpoint value (% or W, matching the array's output type).
